source: code: openai/codex at tag rust-v0.171.0, codex-rs/protocol/src/error.rs (UsageLimitReachedError, RetryLimitReachedError, CodexErr) and codex-rs/codex-api/src/api_bridge.rs (429 handling)

detection.exec_json: an {"type":"error"} event, then {"type":"turn.failed","error":{"message":...}}; text only, no typed code
detection.http: 429 with body error.type usage_limit_reached; usage_not_included and insufficient_quota map to the same codex_error_info; any other 429 is retried and ends as the retry-limit error

templates.limit_named: You’ve hit your usage limit for {limit_name}. Switch to another model now,{retry_after_or}
templates.plus: You’ve hit your usage limit. Upgrade to Pro (https://chatgpt.com/explore/pro), visit https://chatgpt.com/settings/usage to purchase more credits{retry_after_or}
templates.team_business_enterprise_cbp: You’ve hit your usage limit. To get more access now, send a request to your admin{retry_after_or}
templates.free_go: You’ve hit your usage limit. Upgrade to Plus to continue using Codex (https://chatgpt.com/explore/plus),{retry_after_or}
templates.pro: You’ve hit your usage limit. Visit https://chatgpt.com/settings/usage to purchase more credits{retry_after_or}
templates.workspace_owner_credits_depleted: Your workspace is out of credits. Add credits to continue.
templates.workspace_member_credits_depleted: Your workspace is out of credits. Ask your workspace owner to refill in order to continue.
templates.workspace_owner_spend_cap: You hit your spend cap set in your workspace. Increase your spend cap to continue.
templates.workspace_member_spend_cap: You hit your spend cap set by the owner of your workspace. Ask an owner to increase your spend cap to continue.
templates.usage_not_included: To use Codex with your ChatGPT plan, upgrade to Plus: https://chatgpt.com/explore/plus.
templates.quota_exceeded: Quota exceeded. Check your plan and billing details.
templates.retry_limit: exceeded retry limit, last status: {status}{, request id: {id}}
templates.retry: Try again at {reset}. | Try again later.
templates.retry_after_or: or try again at {reset}. | or try again later.
templates.reset: same local day: {h}:{mm} {AM|PM}; otherwise: {Mon} {d}{st|nd|rd|th}, {yyyy} {h}:{mm} {AM|PM}; the process's local time zone, not named
